   - The value of the house increased by 150%.

   \[
   \text{New value of the house} = 80,000 + 120,000 = 200,000
   \]

   - Profit is calculated as the new value of the house minus the total investment:
   \[
   \text{Profit} = \text{New value of the house} - \text{Total investment}
   \]
   \[
   \text{Profit} = 200,000 - 130,000 = 70,000
   \]

Thus, Josh made a profit of **$70,000**.
